view.title: Discarded Reliquary
view.text: A traveler's pack lies split open at the trail's edge, its owner nowhere to be found. Among the ruined provisions, a single card sits face-down, deliberately placed — as though left as a warning, not a gift.

choices.label: Take it with you (gain a Guilt curse; the pack has 45 cinders)
choices.resultText: You pick it up before you can think better of it. It settles into your deck like it was always there.

choices.label: Burn the pack (gain 25 cinders; leave the card)
choices.resultText: The provisions catch fast. The face-down card curls to ash before you can read it.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You step around the pack and do not look back.

outcome.resultText: You pick it up before you can think better of it. It settles into your deck like it was always there.

view.title: The Keeper of the Nameless
view.text:
A figure in grave-clothes waits at a fork in the road, a lantern of cinder-light held low.

It knows the cairn of broken swords. It knows what you did there. It has been walking since.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The keeper does not follow. It only needed to be seen.

outcome.resultText: The keeper does not follow. It only needed to be seen.

view.title: Golden Moth
view.text: A moth the size of a shield rests on a broken pillar, wings dusted with cinder-light. It is dying, slowly and without complaint. Cinders drip from its wings like pollen.

choices.label: Gather the falling cinders (gain 40 cinders)
choices.resultText: The cinders come away easily. The moth watches you with something like approval.

choices.label: Sit with it a while (heal 10% max HP)
choices.resultText: You keep the vigil. When you rise, some of its lightness has passed to you.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Some deaths are not yours to attend.

view.title: Stake of the Martyr
view.text: A stake of gilded thorn juts from the path, humming with the promise of return. It asks for a piece of you to hold in trust — a card, and a measure of your vigor — and offers a relic drawn up from where the dead wait.

choices.label: Give what it asks (remove a random card, lose 8% max HP, gain a random relic)
choices.resultText: The stake drinks a card and a breath of your strength, and hands back something older than either.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You step around the thorn. It hums after you, patient, certain you'll be back.

outcome.resultText: The stake drinks a card and a breath of your strength, and hands back something older than either.

view.title: Sleeping Smith
view.text: A smith slumps over his anvil, hammer still loose in one hand. His forge is cold, but the blade laid across it hums like it remembers heat. He does not stir when you approach.

choices.label: Take the blade (upgrade a random card)
choices.resultText: The hum quiets the moment it leaves the anvil, as if it was only ever waiting for a hand.

choices.label: Wake him (pay 30 cinders, heal 12% max HP)
choices.resultText: He blinks awake just long enough to press a cold coin into your palm, and something in you settles.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You let him sleep. The blade goes on humming behind you.

outcome.resultText: The hum quiets the moment it leaves the anvil, as if it was only ever waiting for a hand.

view.title: The Caravan Comes Through
view.text:
The Road Warden stands beside Lantern Haven’s mud-spattered wagons. The last one carries the lantern you helped raise.

"You bought these people a road. We can pay our debt. That strongbox is for medicine at the next trading post; it belongs to the cold hamlets."

choices.label: Steal the emergency strongbox (gain 100 cinders and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: No one stops you. A driver crosses the medicine purchase off Lantern Haven’s manifest. The hamlets’ names remain beneath it, with nothing beside them.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You wave the wagons onward, asking nothing in return.

outcome.resultText: No one stops you. A driver crosses the medicine purchase off Lantern Haven’s manifest. The hamlets’ names remain beneath it, with nothing beside them.

view.title: Wyrm Trial
view.text: A cracked stone ring marks a trial-ground no map names. A single soldier stands within it, unmoving, waiting for someone foolish or hungry enough to step inside.

choices.label: Enter the ring (fight the soldier for 60 cinders)
choices.resultText: You step across the stone line. The soldier finally moves.

choices.label: Circle it instead (lose 5% max HP crossing the rubble, gain 20 cinders)
choices.resultText: The rubble takes its toll, but the ring — and whatever waits in it — stays quiet.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Some rings are drawn for a reason. You leave this one closed.

outcome.resultText: You step across the stone line. The soldier finally moves.
